scoring_justification: Full recomputation of extended Hückel tight‑binding calculations is not feasible in the lightweight verifier environment; instead we compare the agent's reported energy differences to the paper‑reported reference values within tolerances, verify the sign pattern (Fe negative, Co/Ni positive) and the relative ordering (Fe < Co < Ni).

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference total energy differences ΔE (distorted − undistorted) from extended Hückel calculations for TaM2Te2 layers (M=Fe,Co,Ni).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Angew. Chem. 1992, 104, 232: Fe distorted preferred by 0.26 eV; Co and Ni undistorted preferred by 0.69 eV and 2.34 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted exactly from the published paper text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the actual numbers reported by the authors and are consistent with the reference oracle solve.sh.

outputs.description: Total energy differences between distorted and undistorted TaM2Te2 layers for M=Fe, Co, Ni. The checker will compare these values to hidden reference values (paper-reported) with tolerances and verify the sign pattern and relative ordering (Fe < Co < Ni).

output_contract.notes: The DOS, COOP, and band-structure analyses are not included in the scored contract; the task focuses on the main quantitative energetic trend.
